column1: # The kind of each registration in port/tools must equal the kind here; change both
# together and say why.  REQUIRED: the browser client is broken without the patch, a
# failure fails the build.  FEATURE, PERF, TELEMETRY: the vanilla code stays correct, a
# census: the category of the arch census (patch-wasm-classification.tsv) the review
# started from, '-' for ids the census did not see.  wasm: 'same' when the reason holds
# for the wasmgc target too, 'js-only' when only the JavaScript build needs the patch
# (JSPI, native i64/f32 or exact vanilla code on wasmgc; the REQUIRED ones name only the js
# target in their spec and port/tools/target-skips/wasmgc.txt lists them, the PERF ones still
# run on wasmgc until a measurement retargets them),
# 'wasm-only' for a patch of the wasmgc target only.
